# QR Gear - Custom QR Code Merchandise Platform

> QR Gear creates personalized apparel and products featuring QR codes that link to digital content.

## What We Do

QR Gear is a print-on-demand merchandise platform specializing in QR code products. We create custom t-shirts, hats, mugs, and bags with scannable QR codes that link to:
- Text messages and URLs
- Hosted images and photo galleries
- Dynamic content that can be updated over time
- Business listings and promotional pages

## Product Lines

### 1. Simple Text QR
- QR code contains text or URL directly
- No hosting required - works offline
- Optional text above/below QR (+$2 each)
- Available on all products

### 2. Pre-designed QR Gifts
- Curated background designs (religious, sports, business themes)
- Customer's QR placed on beautiful template
- Great for gifts and events

### 3. Fully Custom QR Gifts
- Customer uploads their own image
- Add text overlay with font/color choices
- Hosting included (1yr/3yr/5yr/permanent options)

### 4. Dynamic QR (Subscription)
- QR links to page customer controls
- Change displayed content anytime
- Perfect for businesses, memorials, events
- 30-day scripture rotations available

## Use Cases

- **Business Promotion**: Shirts/hats with QR to business website or listing
- **Faith-Based Gifts**: Scripture cups, devotional merchandise
- **Memorial Tributes**: Products linking to tribute pages with photos
- **Event Merchandise**: Conference shirts with event info QR
- **Leave-Behind Marketing**: Professional gifts that keep working

## Integration with Kingdom Connects

QR Gear integrates with Kingdom Connects, a Christian business directory. KC business owners can order promotional items with QR codes linking directly to their KC listing.

## Pricing

- Base products start at $18
- Text above QR: +$2 (20 characters)
- Text below QR: +$2 (30 characters)  
- Extended hosting tiers available for dynamic content
